concepts.learning_objective: Define biodiversity as the number and variety of organisms, their genes and ecosystems in a region.
Explain why biodiversity is uneven on the earth and richest in the tropics.
Describe genetic diversity as variation of genes within a species.
Explain species diversity and how it is measured.
Explain ecosystem diversity and why ecosystem boundaries are hard to demarcate.
Explain how species diversity makes ecosystems stable and productive.
Identify the economic commodities and agro-biodiversity that biodiversity supplies.
Explain the scientific and ethical value of every species.
Analyse the human and natural causes of biodiversity loss, including exotic species.
Distinguish between endangered, vulnerable and rare species as classified by IUCN.
Describe the Earth Summit, the world conservation strategy and India's Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.
Explain mega diversity centres and biodiversity hotspots.
